newsitem.title: CANADA: MOTOR RACING-WURZ UNHURT AFTER CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-WURZ UNHURT AFTER CRASH.

text.p: Austrian debutant Alex Wurz escaped unhurt after crashing his Benetton into a wall on the start-finish straight five minutes from the end of Saturday's qualifying for Sunday's Canadian Grand Prix.
The accident, in which his car grazed a concrete barrier and lose its front right wheel, resulted in the session being halted.
Wurz, looking groggy, was helped from his car, but was able to stand and walk back to the team's garage unaided, talking to reporters in the pit lane.
Canadian Jacques Villeneuve was in provisional pole position in his Williams at the time of the stoppage.
